summary: A Yes vote authorizes the Plumas Lake Elementary School District to issue $9,000,000 in general obligation bonds to construct and furnish a gymnasium at Plumas Lake Junior High School, repaid by a property tax levied at an estimated $12 per $100,000 of assessed valuation while the bonds are outstanding.
